description: This is a JUnit test class named UpgradeUtilTest, which tests the methods of the UpgradeUtil class related to retrieving concept IDs for units within the OpenMRS platform. It contains test methods that verify successful retrieval and failure scenarios when the units are not specified properly.

classes.name: UpgradeUtilTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the UpgradeUtil utility methods.

methods.name: getConceptIdForUnits_shouldReturnConcept_idForDrug_order_quantity_units
methods.description: Tests that the getConceptIdForUnits method correctly retrieves the concept ID when the unit is properly specified.

methods.name: getConceptIdForUnits_shouldFailIfUnitsIsNotSpecified
methods.description: Tests that the getConceptIdForUnits method throws an APIException when the units are not specified in the upgrade file.
